methodology: Listings describe external platforms offering tasks, services, studies, or digital-product opportunities. Reward and availability are indicative and must be verified on the official source.

opportunities.title: Paid research studies
opportunities.description: Take academic and product research studies matched to your profile.
opportunities.reward: Usually a few dollars per study
opportunities.requirements: Account approval and honest demographic profile.

opportunities.title: Test websites and apps
opportunities.description: Record your screen and voice while completing tasks on websites and apps.
opportunities.requirements: Microphone, compatible device, and passing sample test.

opportunities.title: Microtasks and data work
opportunities.description: Complete categorization, text, research, photo, and data-verification tasks.
opportunities.requirements: Verified account; some projects require assessments.

opportunities.title: Online data-labeling tasks
opportunities.description: Help evaluate search, content, images, and AI data through short tasks.
opportunities.requirements: Identity and payment verification may be required.

opportunities.title: AI training and evaluation projects
opportunities.description: Apply for remote data-collection, transcription, evaluation, and AI-training projects.
opportunities.requirements: Application, screening, and sometimes language or specialist skills.

opportunities.title: Human Intelligence Tasks (HITs)
opportunities.description: Complete short data, research, transcription, and moderation tasks posted by requesters.
opportunities.reward: Often cents to a few dollars per HIT
opportunities.requirements: Worker account, tax information, and requester qualifications.

opportunities.title: Sell a small digital service
opportunities.description: Offer a focused service such as translation, thumbnails, data cleanup, voiceover, or short writing.
opportunities.requirements: Clear gig, samples, delivery time, and account verification.

opportunities.title: Apply to small freelance projects
opportunities.description: Find short contracts for admin support, design, writing, coding, research, and translation.
opportunities.requirements: Profile, portfolio, proposal, and platform eligibility.

opportunities.title: Compete for small freelance jobs
opportunities.description: Browse projects and contests for design, writing, data entry, marketing, and development.
opportunities.availability: Global; bid and contest rules apply
opportunities.requirements: Profile, proposal or submission, and current platform rules.

opportunities.title: Join paid interviews and studies
opportunities.description: Apply for research interviews and product studies looking for specific roles or experiences.
opportunities.requirements: Accurate profile and eligibility for each study.

opportunities.title: Participate in mobile research missions
opportunities.description: Share diary entries, videos, photos, and feedback in selected research missions.
opportunities.effort: Days to weeks in short sessions
opportunities.requirements: Mobile device, detailed applications, and mission completion.

opportunities.title: Sell a small digital product
opportunities.description: Publish templates, guides, presets, spreadsheets, or other original digital downloads.
opportunities.reward: You set the price; sales dependent
opportunities.requirements: Original product, clear license, and audience or distribution plan.
